description.value:
Duration constant

No non-magical structure, barrier, vehicle, or object can meaningfully impede you: you destroy or pass through any such thing as a single action, whatever its size or Hardness. Against magical barriers, walls, and force effects, your Strikes count as a counteract attempt at your level using your Class DC.

cinderfall.incomplete: Destroys/passes through any mundane structure as one action of any size/Hardness; against magical barriers, Strikes count as a counteract attempt at the caster's level using Class DC. No "Counteract" rule-element key exists anywhere in the module list -- granting a Strike the ability to function as a counteract attempt has no hook.
